theorems.name: Submission.variation_jacobian_family
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U K : Set (Rn N)) (φ : ℝ → Rn N → Rn N), let g : ℝ × (Rn N × (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N)) → ℝ := fun p ↦ Real.sqrt ((1 - p.2.2 + p.2.2 ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ (φ p.1) p.2.1) ∘L fderiv ℝ (φ p.1) p.2.1 ∘L p.2.2).det); (IsAdmissibleDeformation 2 U K φ → (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ P : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, P ∘L P = P → ContDiffAt ℝ 1 g (0, (x, P))) ∧ ∀ (M : Set (Rn N)) (y : Rn N), y ∈ U → HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ g (t, (y, tangentProjection M y))) (tangentialDivergence M (initialVelocity φ) y) 0) ∧ (IsAdmissibleDeformation 3 U K φ → (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ P : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, P ∘L P = P → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g (0, (x, P))) ∧ ∀ (M : Set (Rn N)) (y : Rn N), y ∈ U → HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ deriv (fun s ↦ g (s, (y, tangentProjection M y))) t) (secondVariationIntegrand M φ y) 0) ∧ ∀ r : ℕ∞, IsAdmissibleDeformation r U K φ → ∀ (M : Set (Rn N)) (y : Rn N), y ∉ K → tangentialDivergence M (initialVelocity φ) y = 0 ∧ secondVariationIntegrand M φ y = 0
